slug: 2025-07-23 Review of the Comoros Data Protection Law

facts.fact: TechHive Advisory states the Union of Comoros enacted its Protection of Personal Data Law on 29 June 2021 as a comprehensive framework; it does not say whether the law has commenced.
TechHive Advisory states the law establishes a National Authority for the Protection of Personal Data but that as of mid-2024 it had not been formally constituted or made operational.
